items.title: Shady Bug Announce New Album I wanted to be there: Hear “my night routine”
items.summary: Please welcome yet another cool band to the Julia's War Recordings roster. Julia's War, the Philadelphia label founded by They Are Gutting A Body Of Water frontman Doug Dulgarian, is on a pretty absurd winning streak right now, putting out strong recent records from acts like Total Wife, Mx Lonely, God Of War, and Melaina Kol. For their next trick, they'll get together with Bee Side Cassettes to release the new LP from the St. Louis band Shady Bug.
